title: memory-path flip ladder: pJ per flipped bit, and per carried one, at four levels
question: Q128 section 5 item 5: no flip ladder on a memory path; a DRAM tensor load costs 94-134 pJ/B against a MAC's 5.783 pJ
registered_by: kern-dev (Q129 workflow), on aifoundry1, build and dry run only
card_state: 600 MHz pinned; harts 1 (1,024 harts, 32 per shire); board energy above idle

patterns.l1: ld_l1 (EC_LD_L1): 8 x flw.ps over the 256 B image, L1 hit
patterns.l2_l3_dram: flw_pat (EC_FLW_PAT): 32 B vector loads, --stride 64, one 64 B line per load

levels.l2: 8 KB per hart = 256 KB per shire (half the L2)
levels.l3: 24 KB per hart = 24 MB in all
levels.dram: 128 KB per hart = 128 MB in all, 4x the 32 MB L3 (labelled dram_4x_l3)

predictions.P6_ordering: e_flip monotone l1 < l2 < l3 < dram, spanning at least 100x

decision.estimator: per level, within-pass least squares of board power on changed bits per transfer over the k-arm; averaged over passes; two-sided t on the between-pass scatter; converted with each run's own measured bytes_per_s, never an assumed rate; the w-arm fitted the same way for e_one
decision.saturation: signed departure of the top rung from the line through the two lowest rungs, with its interval
decision.burst_gate: drop a run whose telemetry median took_ms > 60 ms; a level losing more than a third of its runs in a pass is reported unresolved, not averaged
decision.temperature: preheat 59 C, launch at the first reading <= 58 C, cap 78 C; three unreachable runs in a row void the pass; slopes with and without a temperature covariate
decision.scratchpad: OUT OF SCOPE and why: the host cannot seed a scratchpad (--scp makes the kernel read EC_SCP_ADDR, which no host fill reaches); a scratchpad rung needs a kernel mode that copies the image in first

waterfall: does not move the 3.837 pJ unaccounted on the multiply-add (that is arithmetic); it closes the second half of section 5 item 5, turns the load-to-watts model's memory term into a measured coefficient, and splits the published zeros-vs-random chord into a per-flipped-bit and a per-carried-one price at four levels
